rationale: Reactive current priority: iq = k*(deadband - v) clipped at current_limit for each sample below the 0.9 pu deadband. Active current is the pre-fault value limited by remaining apparent-current capability sqrt(limit^2 - iq^2). Minimum voltage is 0.48 pu, above the 0.45 pu ride-through floor; no low-voltage interval exceeds 0.2 s; and reactive-current requirements are met, so the response is FRT compliant.
